subject: Archer onboarding - sample package & field-mapping request
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Morales <security@veridian.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Archer onboarding - sample package & field-mapping request

Hi Evan —

Thanks for the quick intake on Archer. We're preparing a minimal "sample package" that should be sufficient for your initial proof-of-possession and field-mapping validation rather than a full profile import. Goal: accelerate onboarding so your team can verify mappings and accept the profile delta before we do a full CAIQ/SOC2 bundle.

What we're planning to upload to Archer this week (single upload):
- archer_sample_manifest_v1.csv (records + field labels)
- caiaq-sample-snippets.json (CAIQ sections mapped to our internal control ids)
- redwood_retention_excerpt.pdf (short excerpt showing retention policy for S3/staging)

Quick asks:
1) Can you confirm Archer will accept a single manifest upload with these file types?
2) Do you prefer a presigned S3 link or direct portal upload?
3) Any required field names on your side for the CAIQ -> Archer mapping (we have a suggested map but want to align).

If that sounds good I'll upload the manifest and presign the bucket for 72 hours and share the link. Attaching the manifest + CAIQ snippets for your review.

Thanks —
Alex Martinez
Security Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: archer_sample_manifest_v1.csv (stub), caiaq-sample-snippets.json (stub)

From: Evan Morales <security@veridian.io>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@veridian.com
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:18:12 -04:00
Subject: Re: Archer onboarding - sample package & field-mapping request

Alex —

Thanks for the clear plan. A few clarifying items from our side before we accept the sample:
- We do accept CSV + JSON bundles. For the manifest row schema, please include a column named "retention_class" and a boolean-ish "proof_possession" flag.
- Presigned S3 link is preferred; please include the expected object paths and an expiry of at least 48 hours.
- For CAIQ snippets, we need the control id to be included (e.g., CAIQ-A.9.1) so our ingest can map automatically.
- Please confirm SOC 2 scope tag (if this sample should be treated as "in-scope" for SOC 2 evidence).

I've attached our Archer template (veridian_portal_template.xlsx) — it lists the exact field names we use for mapping. If you can populate a short mapping doc (CAIQ control -> Archer field) that would speed validation.

Evan Morales
Security Program Lead, Veridian Systems
security@veridian.io

Attachment: veridian_portal_template.xlsx (stub)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Morales <security@veridian.io>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 12:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Archer onboarding - sample package & field-mapping request

Evan —

Appreciate the detail. Short answers inline:
- retention_class: we'll add the retention_class column to the manifest and populate with our standard classes (short-term, analytics, audit-long).
- proof_possession: we'll add a proof_possession column and set true for the rows included in the sample.
- Presigned S3: we'll create a presigned URL for a single bucket/prefix: s3://redwood-archer-uploads/veridian/samples/2026-09-29/ with 72h expiry. I'll share the link once it's generated.
- SOC 2: mark this sample as "in-scope" (SOC2: PROD-serve model inference path). We'll attach the SOC 2 tag in the CAIQ snippets.

Alex — can you confirm the CAIQ control ids are included in caiaq-sample-snippets.json (control -> excerpt -> mapping id)? If not, we can add a small mapping.csv with columns: caig_id, archer_field. I've attached a short retention excerpt for reference.

Rishi Malhotra
Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: redwood_retention_excerpt.pdf (excerpt)

Rishi / Alex —

Thanks — that plan works for Veridian. Two small asks before we close the validation:
1) Please upload the manifest + CAIQ snippets to the presigned S3 prefix and confirm the object keys in reply. We'll run an ingest job and validate field mapping.
2) Please attach a small CSV mapping table (column: caig_id -> archer_field) with the upload. We'll use that to automate the ingest.

If both are present we can confirm acceptance and move the profile into a staging import window next week.

I'll also loop in procurement if there are any licensing or upload quotas to coordinate. Looking forward to the upload.

Best —
